style.backgroundSystem: airy summer sky backdrop #BFE0EA with soft clouds and rounded deep-teal arch shapes, alternating with pearl-white rounded cards #FDFBF8 that fade to blush #F7D9D0
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside soft rounded gradient pill labels, single stroke weight, #235B66
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key daylight, front or upper-side key around 5500K, gentle soft shadows, clean breezy summer mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer outdoor accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of airy sky blue #BFE0EA, pearl white #FDFBF8, deep teal text #235B66, and one coral-orange accent #F2916B, with blush #F7D9D0 as the card fade tone; cool bright high-key daylight with soft shadows around 5500K; modern geometric sans-serif with deep teal headlines in 「」, one family only; airy sky backdrops with soft clouds and rounded arch shapes alternating with pearl-white rounded cards fading to blush; thin-line icons inside soft rounded gradient pill labels; hat shown true to brim shape with stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: hat either worn by a generic person framed without a recognizable face, held in fully formed hands, or centered solo; brim shape kept true, stable scale across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: flat matte panels and soft cloud gradients, no hard tabletop; true woven straw texture reserved for close-ups
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, deep teal #235B66 headlines in 「」, one family only; blush #F7D9D0 kept as the card fade tone and soft panel tint
